ground_truth_witness: Take V=ℝ with its usual real scalar multiplication and semi-inner product ⟨x,y⟩=xy. It is bilinear, symmetric, and ⟨x,x⟩=x²≥0 (indeed positive definite).
ground_truth_flaw: Every real semi-inner product space is, with the same given structure, a complex semi-inner product space.
